evidence_strings_used_by_verifier_only.evaluation_evidence: The paper evaluates math/logical reasoning accuracy on CSQA, GPQA, GSM8K, and QASC; creative-writing length-controlled win rate on Writing Prompts; human preference for Llama2-7B Writing Prompts outputs; diversity via n-gram repetition diversity; generation length; and inference efficiency via sampling time, CPU time, RAM usage, and pairwise t-tests. Baselines include top-p, min-p, epsilon-sampling, eta-sampling, Mirostat, greedy decoding, and beam search.
evidence_strings_used_by_verifier_only.experimental_setting_evidence: Main experiments use Llama-2-7B-Chat, Mistral-7B-Instruct, and Llama3-70B-Instruct over temperatures 0.5, 0.7, 1.0, 1.5, and 2.0. Reasoning tasks use CSQA, GPQA, GSM8K, and QASC, with 8-shot chain-of-thought prompts for CSQA/GSM8K/QASC. Writing Prompts uses 100 sampled prompts and default sampling at temperature 1.0 as reference. Llama2-7B reasoning results average three random seeds; Mistral-7B and Llama3-70B use one seed due to compute constraints. Appendix experiments include DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B and generalized k-order thresholds.
evidence_strings_used_by_verifier_only.gap_evidence: Sampling-based LLM decoding often needs task- and temperature-specific hyperparameter tuning. Fixed-threshold or single-token-relative truncation methods can degrade at high temperature, admit too many low-quality tail tokens, or require edge-case fallbacks when the candidate set becomes empty.
evidence_strings_used_by_verifier_only.method_evidence: p-less computes a threshold from the entire temperature-adjusted token distribution: L[P] = sum_i p_i^2, interpretable as the probability of a correct random guess, the exponential of negative Renyi-2 collision entropy, and a second-moment statistic. Tokens with probability at least L[P] are retained and renormalized before sampling. p-lessnorm relaxes the threshold to (|V| * sum_i p_i^2 - 1) / (|V| - 1), favoring diversity when coherence pressure can be lower.
evidence_strings_used_by_verifier_only.result_and_limitation_evidence: p-less and p-lessnorm have top or near-top AUC across most reasoning datasets and models. Table 1 reports, for example, Mistral-7B AUCs of p-less/p-lessnorm: CSQA 0.697/0.692, GPQA 0.239/0.222, GSM8K 0.562/0.564, QASC 0.736/0.739; Llama2-7B p-less/p-lessnorm: CSQA 0.503/0.503, GPQA 0.242/0.248, GSM8K 0.267/0.267, QASC 0.537/0.538. On Writing Prompts, p-less is stable at high temperature: Llama2-7B p-less wins 65.64 at temperature 2.0 while top-p, epsilon, and eta collapse to 0.00. Sampling time is lowest for p-less at 0.01942 seconds per token versus min-p 0.02497 and top-p 0.02362.

paper_claims.efficiency: p-less has the lowest reported average sampling time per token in Table 3.
paper_claims.gap: Sampling methods need task/temperature hyperparameter tuning; fixed or single-token thresholds degrade or require fallbacks.
paper_claims.high_temperature_writing: p-less remains stable at high temperature while top-p, epsilon, and eta collapse in the reported Writing Prompts setting.
paper_claims.main_auc: p-less and p-lessnorm are top or near-top across most reasoning datasets and models.
paper_claims.method: p-less uses the full distribution second moment sum_i p_i^2 as a dynamic threshold; p-lessnorm relaxes it.

title: p-less Sampling: A Robust Hyperparameter-Free Approach for LLM Decoding
